August 16, 1955

Mr. Jesse M. Hess
52 Riverside Drive
New York, New York

Dear Mr. Hessi

Thank you for your letter of August 10 on the subject of smoking and health.

As you may know, research in the area of smoking and health is now being conducted on behalf of the entire industry by the Tobacco Industry Research Committee, 5320 Empire State Building, New York, New York. I have taken the liberty of referring your letter to the Committee's Executive Secretary, Mr. W. T. Hoyt.

Again, many thanks for thinking of our Company in this connection.

Sincerely,

Robert K. Heimann
Executive Assistant

cc: Mr. W. T. Hoyt
